packs.title: United States Court of Federal Claims

scenario_library.summary: 28 U.S.C. §1498(a) patent case in the Court of Federal Claims: the government's unlicensed use/manufacture of a patented invention, patent-track procedure through trial or summary judgment.

calibration_sets.title: Court of Federal Claims bid-protest volume, FY2024

result.request: the `request` JSON Schema (see `schemas`): {packs, links, no_continuations, no_flags, max_product_nodes, scenario, op}; `scenario` is an inline object, a name from `scenario_library`, or {"extends": "<name>", ...overrides} deep-merged onto it (the `named-scenario` schema for a library entry's shape)

scenario.cost: metric name or inline expr (default dollars)
scenario.utility: utility name or inline expr (default ev)
scenario.probability_fn: edge-expr rewriting p on world edges (p = authored or NaN), chance nodes renormalized
scenario.policy: {node ref: edge ref} force our move
scenario.facts: {node ref: edge ref} force a `fact`-tagged chance node to its true branch (unset uses the authored prior + warns `fact-unset`)
scenario.mixed: nature-first (default; falls back to act-or-wait) | act-or-wait | self-only | optimistic
scenario.opponent_models: {node ref: {model: adversarial} | {model: chance, probabilities?: {edge ref: p}} | {model: own-objective, payoffs: {edge ref: usd}}} how the opponent decides at one node where only they choose (e.g. a calibrated chance a stipulation is accepted, or their own payoff of each response); overrides opponent and, there, opponent_objective; unused entries warn opponent-model-unused
scenario.objective: {type: expected} | {type: cara, a} | {type: worst} | {type: cvar, alpha, grid?, y_lo?, y_hi?} (optimizes CVaR_alpha, not just reports it; y_lo/y_hi override the default grid bound, set together; see docs/CRITIQUE.md) | {type: robust, credibility?, radius?, samples?, seed?} (worst case over each chance node's Dirichlet credible L1 set; solve adds nominal vs robust value and policy changes; see docs/UNCERTAINTY.md)
scenario.fee_shift: {fraction, eligible?: terminal-expr} recover fraction of our accumulated cost at each eligible terminal (default eligible: tag('fee-eligible')); replaces the packs' per-terminal feeShift (the statutory default)
scenario.fee_shifts: {terminal ref: fraction} this matter's fee-shift fraction at one terminal; overrides fee_shift and the pack's feeShift there
scenario.calibration: [calibration set id, ...] — see calibration_sets below and the `calibration` schema; applied values are authored exactly as if hand-typed into the pack, reported in provenance.calibration
scenario.opponent_objective: terminal-expr: the opponent's own payoff (general-sum, subgame-perfect equilibrium) instead of a zero-sum adversary; see docs/CRITIQUE.md
scenario.uncertainty: {default_concentration?, concentration?: {node ref: pseudo-counts}} Dirichlet prior strength per chance node; default: a calibration entry's n, else 10 (an estimate, warned prior-concentration-estimated); see docs/UNCERTAINTY.md
scenario.observe: {node ref: {edge ref: count}} observed outcomes (e.g. this judge granted 3 of 4); conjugate Dirichlet update, every op then uses the posterior mean

ops.validate: resolve packs + scenario without running anything
ops.metric: {spec, top?} evaluate a metric on every edge — test custom functions here
ops.explain: {node?, from?} who decides, every option with q/regret/cost/what-happens-next; at a node with state-flag copies, a base id is explained in the replayed context (`context`) and the other copies summarized (`other_contexts`)
ops.solve: {from?, full_policy?, all_values?, max_steps?} value + best line; adds cvar/zeta/alpha/grid under objective cvar, or opponent_value(s) when scenario.opponent_objective is set
ops.chain: {from?, metrics?, top?} absorption probabilities + expected totals under the optimal policy
ops.simulate: {from?, runs?, seed?, metrics?, alpha?, max_steps?, sample_durations?, samples?} outcome distribution, CVaR, P(loss)
ops.path: {from?, to?, metric?, k?, report?} shortest / k-shortest lines; to = node | terminals | tag:<outcome>
ops.pareto: {from?, to?, objectives?, max_labels?, limit?} N-objective frontier (default dollars × elapsed × surprise)
ops.sweep: {param, lo?, hi?, steps?, watch?, tol?} value curve + policy breakpoints for ANY param
ops.tornado: {params?, rel?, dp?, probabilities?, top?} what the answer is most sensitive to
ops.calibration: {top?, dp?, rel?, max_candidates?} uncalibrated probabilities/durations ranked by decision sensitivity — what to calibrate next
ops.posterior: {from?, node?, samples?, seed?, credibility?} Monte Carlo over every chance node's Dirichlet posterior: credible intervals on the value and on each option's Q at node, and P(each option is optimal)
ops.voi: {from?, samples?, seed?, top?, max_nodes?, studies?: [{node, k, cost? | cost_edge?, label?}]} value of information: EVPI of each chance node's outcome and probabilities, EVPI of everything, EVSI of each study (k observations) vs its cost
ops.deadlines: {trigger, edge?, node?, reachable?, service_method?, additional_holidays?, clerk_inaccessible?} concrete due dates + computation steps for authored deadline specs (counted under the clock-library rule named by the pack's `counting` field; the `clock` schema)
ops.settle: {node?, self_side?: plaintiff|defendant, opponent_risk?: objective, bargaining_power?, discount_annual?: {plaintiff?, defendant?}, delta?: {plaintiff?, defendant?}, rule68?: {offer, costs?, eligible?}, runs?, seed?, max_steps?} each side's walk-away value (certainty equivalent under its own objective) -> ZOPA or no-deal gap, midpoint / Nash (symmetric + weighted) / Rubinstein prices, when the surplus peaks along the likely line and how the policy changes with settling always available, FRCP/RCFC 68(d) offer-of-judgment cost shifting; needs scenario.opponent_objective (docs/SETTLEMENT.md)
ops.compare: {variant: scenario merge-patch, inner: op} base vs variant + deltas

metrics.name: dollars
metrics.doc: attorney labor at `rate` plus cash fees (the v1 dollarCost)

metrics.name: days
metrics.doc: deadline window length (v1 `days`). A window, not elapsed time

metrics.name: elapsed
metrics.doc: expected calendar days the transition takes (duration.mode, else deadline length, else 0)

metrics.name: surprise
metrics.doc: -ln(probability); path sum = -ln(path probability), so the shortest path is the most likely line

metrics.name: opponent_dollars
metrics.doc: spend imposed on the opponent (burden you can inflict)

metrics.name: time_value
metrics.doc: dollars plus a per-day carrying cost of delay (`carry_per_day`, e.g. ongoing harm or cost of capital)

metrics.name: traps
metrics.doc: edges that are traps (tagged waiver-trap or valence bad)

utilities.name: loss_averse
utilities.expr: payoff < 0 ? loss_aversion * payoff * stakes : payoff * stakes

params.name: loss_aversion
params.doc: loss multiplier for the loss_averse utility

params.name: carry_per_day
params.doc: per-day cost of delay for time_value

edge_variables.name: elapsed, elapsed_min, elapsed_max
edge_variables.doc: duration in days (falls back to deadline length)

edge_variables.name: p
edge_variables.doc: effective probability under the scenario (1 on non-chance edges)

edge_variables.name: is_self, is_opponent, is_nature
edge_variables.doc: 0/1 role of the edge under the scenario's perspective

edge_variables.name: edge.<attr>
edge_variables.doc: edge attrs (NaN if missing; use attr('x', default))

edge_variables.name: from.<attr>, to.<attr>
edge_variables.doc: node attrs of source/target (NaN if missing)

edge_variables.name: <param>
edge_variables.doc: any scenario parameter (rate, stakes, ... or your own)

edge_functions.name: to_tag("x")
edge_functions.doc: target node has outcome or node tag x

edge_functions.name: from_tag("x")
edge_functions.doc: source node has outcome or node tag x

edge_functions.name: flag("x")
edge_functions.doc: the state-flag product graph has flag x set at the edge's source node (see docs/PACK_SCHEMA.md#state-flags)

terminal_variables.name: payoff
terminal_variables.doc: terminal payoff (USD, protagonist perspective) after overrides

terminal_variables.name: payoff_authored
terminal_variables.doc: 1 if the payoff was authored, 0 if heuristic/default

terminal_variables.name: flag("x")
terminal_variables.doc: this terminal's compiled state-flag product-graph copy has flag x set

terminal_path_variables.name: spent
terminal_path_variables.doc: cumulative cost (the scenario's cost metric) along the actual path to this terminal; exact in `simulate`, 0 in `solve`/`chain` (Markov)

terminal_path_variables.name: elapsed_total
terminal_path_variables.doc: cumulative elapsed days along the actual path; exact in `simulate` (sampled durations if enabled), 0 in `solve`/`chain`

terminal_path_variables.name: steps
terminal_path_variables.doc: number of edges traversed to reach this terminal; exact in `simulate`, 0 in `solve`/`chain`

math_functions.name: if(c, a, b)
math_functions.doc: a when c != 0 else b (also `c ? a : b`)

result.expression_syntax: c ? a : b, || && == != < <= > >= + - * / % ^, unary - !, calls f(x), "strings" as function args, identifiers may contain dots (edge.x, to.x)
